Nothing I post matters; all my followers, all the brands – it’s all going to be gone. And with that, I just feel this profound sadness, like a weight in my chest that won't lift. Most days are like this now, this deep gloom mixed with the growing certainty of impending doom.

But what’s really odd is that, there was a stretch, about a month or so ago, where I still *knew* the end was near, this catastrophic event was inevitable, but I wasn't really feeling down about it.
